card.name: Linking words before patient or general-population phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" and "in" right after an abstract noun (care, observation, sensitivity, features) in formal label or legal-style text. The next words are usually "the patient", "an individual patient" or "the general population".

modes.label: of after care or observation
modes.description: The word "of" after a noun about caring for or watching a patient, before "the/an patient".
modes.example: Careful observation<< of>> the patient is essential.

modes.label: in before the general population
modes.description: The word "in" after a noun like sensitivity or prevalence, before a population group.
modes.example: The overall prevalence of sulfite sensitivity<< in>> the general population is unknown and probably low

modes.label: Sentence openers and relative words
modes.description: Opening words such as "In general", "If" or "who" that begin a general statement about patients.
modes.example: In<< general>>, dose selection for an elderly patient should
